key: This rock is glowing with energy inside...
en: This rock is glowing with energy inside...
ja: この　いわの　なかで　エネルギーが　かがやいている……

key: Do you want to mine the rock?
en: Do you want to mine the rock?
ja: いわを　さいくつしますか？

key: It seems too sturdy to break or move...
en: It seems too sturdy to break or move...
ja: 頑丈すぎて、壊すことも動かすこともできなそうだ……

key: The rock base may hold more valuables.
en: The rock base may hold more valuables.
ja: 岩の土台には、まだ何か価値のあるものが眠っているかもしれない。

key: Do you want to open it with Blast Powder?
en: Do you want to open it with Blast Powder?
ja: 爆破パウダーで開けてみますか?

key: The entrance has been destroyed...
en: The entrance has been destroyed...
ja: 入口が破壊された……

key: GARDEVOIR: And THAT, kids, is how you storm a castle~
en: GARDEVOIR: And THAT, kids, is how you storm a castle~
ja: サーナイト: これが、お城に殴り込みをかける方法よ、みんな～

key: CAIN: I mean, if you can call this a castle.
en: CAIN: I mean, if you can call this a castle.
ja: カイン: まあ、これを城って呼べるならね。

key: RADOMUS: Gardevoir is capable of calling anything whatever she wishes, and she will readily do so without a care.
en: RADOMUS: Gardevoir is capable of calling anything whatever she wishes, and she will readily do so without a care.
ja: ラドマス: サーナイトは何であれ好きなように呼ぶ力があるし、平気でそうするだろうな。

key: LUNA: I'm so grateful to everyone for coming to save me.
en: LUNA: I'm so grateful to everyone for coming to save me.
ja: ルナ: 助けに来てくださって、皆さんに心から感謝しています。

key: I would like to formally apologize for the inconvenience I've caused.
en: I would like to formally apologize for the inconvenience I've caused.
ja: ご迷惑をおかけしたことを、正式におわびしたいと思います。

key: GARDEVOIR: Luna, darling, you know Master and I would never abandon you!
en: GARDEVOIR: Luna, darling, you know Master and I would never abandon you!
ja: サーナイト: ルナ、あなた、あたしとご主人様があなたを見捨てるはずないでしょう!

key: LUNA: Yes, of course. Thank you so much, Gardevoir.
en: LUNA: Yes, of course. Thank you so much, Gardevoir.
ja: ルナ: ええ、もちろんです。本当にありがとう、サーナイト。

key: CAIN: Haah, I need to stop getting my butt captured, too~
en: CAIN: Haah, I need to stop getting my butt captured, too~
ja: カイン: はぁ、俺もいい加減、捕まってばっかなのやめないとなぁ～

key: I'm never gonna be the very best like no one ever was at this rate.
en: I'm never gonna be the very best like no one ever was at this rate.
ja: このままじゃ、誰も成し得なかった一番になんて、絶対なれやしないよ。

key: RADOMUS: That's all well and good, but perhaps we shouldn't chit-chat idly right on our enemy's doorstep.
en: RADOMUS: That's all well and good, but perhaps we shouldn't chit-chat idly right on our enemy's doorstep.
ja: ラドマス: それは結構だが、敵の玄関先でのんきに雑談するのはよした方がいいのではないかな。

key: LUNA: Master is right.
en: LUNA: Master is right.
ja: ルナ: ご主人様のおっしゃる通りです。

key: I wish to quit this place.
en: I wish to quit this place.
ja: この場所から離れたいです。

key: RADOMUS: It will not do to return to the Castle at this point.
en: RADOMUS: It will not do to return to the Castle at this point.
ja: ラドマス: この期に及んで城に戻るわけにはいかない。

key: At least, I will not be returning.
en: At least, I will not be returning.
ja: 少なくとも、私は戻らないつもりだ。

key: Apologies, Cain, but we will not be able to have our battle just yet.
en: Apologies, Cain, but we will not be able to have our battle just yet.
ja: すまないな、カイン、我々の勝負はまだお預けだ。

key: I have other business to attend to just now.
en: I have other business to attend to just now.
ja: 今は他にやるべきことがあってね。

key: Though I do thank you for the lead from before.
en: Though I do thank you for the lead from before.
ja: とはいえ、先ほどの手がかりには感謝している。

key: Gardevoir?
en: Gardevoir?
ja: サーナイト?

key: GARDEVOIR: Ta-ta, dears~
en: GARDEVOIR: Ta-ta, dears~
ja: サーナイト: それじゃあね、みんな～

key: Stay tuned for our next big entrance!
en: Stay tuned for our next big entrance!
ja: 次の大登場をお楽しみに!

key: CAIN: Wait, what do you mean 'Thanks for the lead'?
en: CAIN: Wait, what do you mean 'Thanks for the lead'?
ja: カイン: 待って、「手がかりに感謝」ってどういうこと?

key: CAIN: ...So, I guess they won't be answering that question then.
en: CAIN: ...So, I guess they won't be answering that question then.
ja: カイン: ……まあ、その質問には答えてくれないってことか。

key: LUNA: Ahaha~ Master does love his mysteries, doesn't he?
en: LUNA: Ahaha~ Master does love his mysteries, doesn't he?
ja: ルナ: あはは～ご主人様は謎めいたことがお好きですものね。

key: Perhaps it's better if he doesn't say.
en: Perhaps it's better if he doesn't say.
ja: おっしゃらない方がいいのかもしれません。

key: LUNA: Hearts beat faster in the darkness.
en: LUNA: Hearts beat faster in the darkness.
ja: ルナ: 闇の中では、心臓の鼓動が速くなるものです。

key: Do you know why?
en: Do you know why?
ja: なぜだかご存知ですか?

key: CAIN: Because it's better with the lights off?
en: CAIN: Because it's better with the lights off?
ja: カイン: 明かりを消した方がいい感じだから?

key: LUNA: Oh, my.
en: LUNA: Oh, my.
ja: ルナ: あら、まあ。

key: Well, be that as it may, it wasn't quite my intention.
en: Well, be that as it may, it wasn't quite my intention.
ja: まあ、それはそれとして、そういう意図ではなかったのですが。

key: But in a different vein, darkness is quick to fester in one's heart.
en: But in a different vein, darkness is quick to fester in one's heart.
ja: ですが別の意味で、闇は人の心の中にすぐに根を張るものです。

key: Tell me, \PN, are you afraid of the dark?
en: Tell me, \PN, are you afraid of the dark?
ja: 教えてください、\PN、あなたは闇が怖いですか?

key: LUNA: Darkness is love.
en: LUNA: Darkness is love.
ja: ルナ: 闇とは愛です。

key: There's nothing to fear.
en: There's nothing to fear.
ja: 恐れることは何もありません。

key: I invite you to discover that for yourself.
en: I invite you to discover that for yourself.
ja: ぜひご自分でそれを確かめてみてください。

key: LUNA: Good.
en: LUNA: Good.
ja: ルナ: いいですね。

key: LUNA: Then why should you have distrusted Master?
en: LUNA: Then why should you have distrusted Master?
ja: ルナ: では、なぜご主人様を疑ったりする必要があるのでしょう?

key: Please, take this.
en: Please, take this.
ja: どうぞ、これを受け取ってください。

key: LUNA: With this, you will be able to enter Iolia Valley.
en: LUNA: With this, you will be able to enter Iolia Valley.
ja: ルナ: これがあれば、イオリア渓谷に入れるようになります。

key: As for how to find it...
en: As for how to find it...
ja: その場所の見つけ方ですが……

key: There is a single tree within my master's Labyrinth.
en: There is a single tree within my master's Labyrinth.
ja: ご主人様の迷宮の中に、一本の木があります。

key: Just behind that, and you can figure out the rest, right?
en: Just behind that, and you can figure out the rest, right?
ja: そのすぐ裏手です。あとはご自分で分かりますよね?

key: LUNA: The darkness in Master's heart bores a hole that I cannot hope to fill alone.
en: LUNA: The darkness in Master's heart bores a hole that I cannot hope to fill alone.
ja: ルナ: ご主人様の心の中の闇は、わたし一人では到底埋められないほどの穴をうがっています。

key: But I can pretend, can't I?
en: But I can pretend, can't I?
ja: でも、そのふりくらいはできますよね?

key: \PN, I'll be waiting.
en: \PN, I'll be waiting.
ja: \PN、お待ちしていますね。

key: CAIN: Sooooo I have no idea what she meant by any of that, but I'm gonna get going too!
en: CAIN: Sooooo I have no idea what she meant by any of that, but I'm gonna get going too!
ja: カイン: いやぁ、あれが何の話だったのかさっぱりだけど、俺も行くとするよ!

key: Since Radomus flew the coop, I guess I'll see if I can give those guards at Agate a wake-up call in a bit.
en: Since Radomus flew the coop, I guess I'll see if I can give those guards at Agate a wake-up call in a bit.
ja: ラドマスがトンズラしちまったし、そろそろアゲートの見張りどもに活を入れてやるとするか。

key: I guess that's still on the other end of Route 1...
en: I guess that's still on the other end of Route 1...
ja: あれってまだ1番道路の向こう側だっけな……

key: If you're going to the labyrinth right away, wanna walk together until the road splits?
en: If you're going to the labyrinth right away, wanna walk together until the road splits?
ja: すぐ迷宮に行くつもりなら、道が分かれるとこまで一緒に歩く?

key: CAIN: Then we depart at once, hand in hand!
en: CAIN: Then we depart at once, hand in hand!
ja: カイン: それじゃ、手に手を取って出発だ!

key: Metaphorically, if nothing else?
en: Metaphorically, if nothing else?
ja: まあ、比喩的にってことで?

key: Oh, and thanks for the save again, darling prince~
en: Oh, and thanks for the save again, darling prince~
ja: ああ、それと、また助けてくれてありがとな、愛しの王子様～

key: CAIN: Our sunlit walk along the boardwalk can wait until another time then~
en: CAIN: Our sunlit walk along the boardwalk can wait until another time then~
ja: カイン: 日差しの中の遊歩道デートは、また今度ってことで～

key: Thanks for the save again, darling prince~
en: Thanks for the save again, darling prince~
ja: また助けてくれてありがとな、愛しの王子様～

key: BENNETT: I thought I saw you, \PN.
en: BENNETT: I thought I saw you, \PN.
ja: ベネット: あなたを見かけた気がしていました、\PN。

key: But to be honest, I couldn't believe it.
en: But to be honest, I couldn't believe it.
ja: ですが正直、信じられませんでした。

key: BENNETT: Then again, I suppose this isn't the sort of place someone like me would choose to be either.
en: BENNETT: Then again, I suppose this isn't the sort of place someone like me would choose to be either.
ja: ベネット: もっとも、私のような人間が好んで来る場所でもありませんが。

key: I was asked to go get some supplies for a certain procedure, so it couldn't be helped.
en: I was asked to go get some supplies for a certain procedure, so it couldn't be helped.
ja: ある処置のための物資を取りに行くよう頼まれたもので、仕方がなかったのです。

key: Of course, they would be cross with me if I let someone just walk into our meeting place unopposed...
en: Of course, they would be cross with me if I let someone just walk into our meeting place unopposed...
ja: 当然、誰かを易々と会合の場に通したとなれば、皆に怒られてしまうでしょうが……

key: But I must return posthaste, for Luna's sake.
en: But I must return posthaste, for Luna's sake.
ja: ですが、ルナのためにも、急いで戻らねばなりません。

key: I assume you are also trying to help Luna?
en: I assume you are also trying to help Luna?
ja: あなたもルナを助けようとしているのでしょう?

key: I see.
en: I see.
ja: そうですか。

key: In that case, there should be no problem.
en: In that case, there should be no problem.
ja: それならば、問題はないでしょう。

key: Just ahead and to the left then, that will do.
en: Just ahead and to the left then, that will do.
ja: この先を左に行けば、それで十分です。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
